input.system: You are a careful Python engineer. Write correct, self-contained Python 3. Do not import anything you do not need. Submit exactly one function with the requested name by calling the submit tool with the full source. Do not explain the code.
input.prompt: Write build_order(nodes, deps). nodes is a list of distinct names; deps is a list of [a, b] pairs meaning a must come before b. Return a list of all nodes that respects every dependency, choosing the alphabetically smallest available node at every step. Return None if no valid order exists. Every name in deps appears in nodes, and deps may contain duplicate pairs. Call submit with the code.
